own_solution.law: L = mu0 N^2 pi a^2 / l = 1.42163e-3 H; I0 = V/R1 = 3 A; heat in second resistor = (1/2) L I0^2
assumptions: steady state before opening; winding resistance negligible

defect_reasons.other: T000E ends 'for one run only' while saying the emf is present before the switch opens in the stated run; the R reading is the natural one but the trailing phrase invites a reader to wonder whether the extra emf belongs to another run.

notes: Checked: L = 1.257e-6 x 640000 x pi x 2.25e-4 / 0.40 = 1.421634e-3 H; L/2 = 0.710817 mJ/A^2. Answers: 3 A -> 6.3974 mJ; 3.8 A -> 10.264 mJ; 4.875 A -> 16.893 mJ; 5.75 A -> 23.501 mJ. All certified values match (my pass-1 values were in J; same numbers). C cancellation of the discharge resistance is correct: integral of I0^2 R exp(-2Rt/L) dt = L I0^2/2, and in steady state the zero-resistance winding shorts the second resistor so it carries no current before opening (the authors' assumptions do not mention this, but it holds). Minimal pairs T200B/T0F51 and T8F98/T000E share 7.5 V and differ only in attachment; T212D and TC1E1 are numeral-free twins. Agree with all strata. Category reflects only the low-severity wording issue in T000E; physics and claims hold.
